## 2. Fabric Botany & Material Engineering

### 100% Pure Normandy Flax Linen
- Certification: European Flax® certified
- Provenance: Atlantic coastal strip of Normandy, France
- Fabric Weight: 260 GSM (Grams per Square Meter) architectural slub
- Processing: Traditional outdoor dew-retting (teillage) utilizing natural dew, soil enzymes, and sunlight without synthetic caustic chemicals
- Thermal Conductivity: Dissipates heat 5x faster than wool and 18x faster than silk
- Moisture Wicking: Absorbs up to 20% of its dry weight in humidity before feeling damp
- Tensile Performance: Flax fibers gain 20% tensile strength when wet, softening progressively with every wash cycle
- Shrinkage: Pre-washed and tumble-softened to guarantee less than 2% residual shrinkage

### Double Gauze Organic Cotton
- Construction: Two plies of 60s combed organic cotton muslin woven together with microscopic interlocking structural stitches
- Air Cushion: Traps a micro-layer of air between plies, acting as an ambient thermal buffer
- Cling Prevention: Undulating puckered surface reduces direct skin contact area by 40% compared to flat poplin
- Ironing Requirement: Non-iron; crinkled natural texture is intentional and deepens with washing

### Heavyweight Corduroy & Botanical Twill
- Weave: Wide-wale tactile corduroy and high-density unbleached botanical twill
- Softening: Mineral washed using natural clay and botanical enzymes for immediate relaxed drape

## 3. Sizing Architecture & Unisex Silhouette

DUKAAN garments are engineered with relaxed, dropped-shoulder geometries that drape comfortably across diverse human frames without rigid gendered constraints.

- Size XS: Chest 34-36 in / 86-91 cm | Waist 28-30 in / 71-76 cm
- Size S: Chest 36-38 in / 91-97 cm | Waist 30-32 in / 76-81 cm
- Size M: Chest 38-40 in / 97-102 cm | Waist 32-34 in / 81-86 cm
- Size L: Chest 40-42 in / 102-107 cm | Waist 34-36 in / 86-91 cm
- Size XL: Chest 42-44 in / 107-112 cm | Waist 36-38 in / 91-97 cm
- Size XXL: Chest 44-46 in / 112-117 cm | Waist 38-40 in / 97-102 cm

Fit Feedback: 93% of patrons report DUKAAN garments fit true to contemporary relaxed sizing.

## 4. Garment Care & Longevity Manual

- Washing: Machine wash on gentle cycle with cold water (30°C / 85°F) or gentle hand wash.
- Detergent: Use mild liquid pH-neutral detergent free of optical brighteners and chlorine bleach.
- Softener: Never use chemical fabric softeners. Add 1/2 cup of distilled white vinegar to final rinse to dissolve mineral residues.
- Drying: Never tumble dry on high heat. Snap garment while damp and line dry on wide wooden hanger in natural shade.
- Wrinkles: Embrace the natural lived-in drape of European linen. If a crisper look is desired, light steam while fabric is slightly damp.
